description: The full-window frame of a product view: the bar across the top, a side panel, the main region (the only part that scrolls), content floating over it, a bar docked at the bottom and bottom navigation. layout="window" draws a desktop window, layout="phone" a phone app screen. The side panel is 18rem wide; panelWidth (or --a63-app-view-panel-width) changes it. A window can add a rail before the panel (an icon column, 4rem, from md up) and an aside after the main region (a thread or details pane, 22rem, from lg up); topBarSpan="main" starts the top bar after the rail and panel, which then run full height. Each safe-area inset has one owner: the top bar takes the top inset (with no top bar, the first block of the main region pads itself); the tab bar takes the bottom inset, else the docked bar, else the main region; the root takes the inline insets. On iOS the frame is native structure (NavigationStack, toolbar, safeAreaInset with AtomActionBar and AtomTabRow), not a component.
